UPDATE portfolios
SET portfolio_status = CASE
    -- PRIORITY 1: FAILURE
    -- If any sub-process has failed, the master status is failed.
    WHEN fdi_status IN ('failed', 'error') 
      OR pdi_status IN ('failed', 'error') 
      OR backtesting_status IN ('failed', 'error') 
      OR modal2_synthesis_status IN ('failed', 'error')
    THEN 'failed'

    -- PRIORITY 2: SUCCESS
    -- All 4 parts must be 'finished' (or 'complete' just to be safe).
    WHEN fdi_status IN ('finished', 'complete') 
     AND pdi_status IN ('finished', 'complete') 
     AND backtesting_status IN ('finished', 'complete') 
     AND modal2_synthesis_status IN ('finished', 'complete')
    THEN 'finished'

    -- PRIORITY 3: RUNNING
    -- If not failed and not finished, it's still running.
    ELSE 'running'
END
WHERE 
    -- Optimization: Only run the update if the status is actually changing.
    portfolio_status IS DISTINCT FROM CASE
        WHEN fdi_status IN ('failed', 'error') 
          OR pdi_status IN ('failed', 'error') 
          OR backtesting_status IN ('failed', 'error') 
          OR modal2_synthesis_status IN ('failed', 'error')
        THEN 'failed'

        WHEN fdi_status IN ('finished', 'complete') 
         AND pdi_status IN ('finished', 'complete') 
         AND backtesting_status IN ('finished', 'complete') 
         AND modal2_synthesis_status IN ('finished', 'complete')
        THEN 'finished'

        ELSE 'running'
    END;
